title: Push
scene: UK late-1980s chart dance-pop / teen pop
notes: Bright, tightly programmed dance-pop, elastic bass, saxophone accents and youthful yearning.

title: The Time
notes: Longer, funk-touched synth-pop grooves alternate with dramatic, increasingly personal ballads.

title: Changing Faces
notes: Guitar-rich pop-funk and sentimental ballads push the duo toward a more adult sound.
